source: docs/specs/characters/phone-budgets.md (2026-10-21): CS2 agents measured over ssh, Unity and Unreal mobile guides, our live Zone 1 capture; proposed by Characters, for Lead and Dom to tune. A GLB under `match` is held to its class: every number below is a ceiling (tris, skinned verts, joints, draws, widest texture side in px, KiB of the file on disk: raw bytes, because gzip output differs between Node/zlib versions and a gate must read the same number on every machine; the gzip wire figure stays in the note and the capture script); `png: false` means no PNG texture. Existing offenders sit in scripts/phone-budget/allow.json with the PR that fixes each, and that list only shrinks.
